name: sandcastle
description: The judgement half of a @c-energie/sandcastle-harness install — the half that has already gone wrong once — in two skills: getting a workspace wired and verified in order, token-free until the image build; and writing or repairing the implementer, reviewer, group-reviewer and planner briefs the agent is actually told the rules by, from that project's own governing documents rather than from a guess.
